call_points.text: NIM is targeted to move towards 3.36% to 3.38% in the short term and 3.45% to 3.50% over the longer term.
Board has permitted raising up to ₹500 Cr of Tier 2 bonds, but no major equity capital raising is foreseen given strong capitalization.
Opex growth guided at 5-6% for the year; the bank aims for full-year positive operating leverage though this quarter lacked it.
ROA targeted to migrate from the 100-115 bps range to 120-125 bps over time; MD declined a concrete ROE figure.
Corporate book is around 40% of loans against a 30% medium-term target; growth was opportunistic on short-duration, better-priced facilities.
Core fee income fell to ₹179 Cr from ₹191 Cr in Q4 and ₹188 Cr in Q1FY26; MD called it an aberration tied to a product-setup change.
FCNR(B) flows are strong; management expects a large part in August-September before the September 30 deadline, but no GIFT City entity or external credit lines limits leverage.
ECL's effective interest rate change is not expected to materially change NII, but the working is still on and no number was given.
Management aims to grow loan book at least in line with industry growth rates (around 15-16%).
NIM is expected to widen further driven by asset mix shift toward retail and MSME and deposit repricing.

operating_notes.text: Gross NPA fell to ₹1,43,050 lakh at Mar-2026 from ₹2,58,150 lakh at Dec-2025 and ₹2,79,983 lakh at Mar-2025.
Retail banking segment result was ₹38,417 lakh in Q4FY26 against ₹16,710 lakh a year earlier, while corporate/wholesale fell to ₹8,078 lakh from ₹12,632 lakh.
Proposed FY26 dividend of ₹0.45 per share amounts to ₹111.79 lakh.
RBI approved Kotak Mahindra Bank acquiring aggregate holding of up to 9.99% of South Indian Bank's paid-up share capital or voting rights, subject to conditions.
Gold loan book ₹24,930 Cr with average LTV of 65.25% and average ticket size of ₹2.94 lakh.
ECLGS limit set at about ₹400 Cr with disbursement of about ₹238 Cr but utilised book of only about ₹50 Cr.
Q1FY27 total recoveries ₹179 Cr, of which technical write-off recovery about ₹60 Cr and interest on NPA about ₹40 Cr.
Q2FY27 gross NPA ₹1,35,484 lakh and net NPA ₹10,271 lakh, with net NPA at 0.09% of net advances.
Q2FY27 capital adequacy ratio (Basel III) 19.40% against 17.70% a year earlier.
Q2FY27 digital banking segment posted a loss of ₹4,599 lakh against a ₹949 lakh profit in Q2FY26.
Q2FY27 NIM reached 3.33%, up 10 bps QoQ and 53 bps YoY.
Total deposits grew 19% YoY to ₹1,37,279 Cr and gross advances grew 19% YoY to ₹1,09,517 Cr.

timeline.summary: The South Indian Bank Limited scheduled a conference call for investors and analysts on May 7, 2026, at 16:00 hrs (IST) to discuss Q4 FY 2025-26 audited financial results, led by **P R Seshadri (MD & CEO)**, **Dolphy Jose (Executive Director)**, and others.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹2,559.48 Cr (+7.8% YoY), net profit ₹407.4 Cr (+19.0% YoY).
2026-05-07: South Indian Bank said RBI, in its May 06, 2026 intimation, approved Kotak Mahindra Bank acquiring up to 9.99% of the Bank's paid-up capital or voting rights, subject to conditions.
The South Indian Bank Limited held a one-on-one virtual meeting with UNIFI CAPITAL on May 08, 2026, without sharing unpublished price-sensitive information.
South Indian Bank reported FY26 net profit of ₹1,455 Cr (+12% YoY) with GNPA improving to 1.43%.

The South Indian Bank Ltd. held an on-one-one physical meeting with Sundaram Asset Management Company Ltd. on May 19, 2026, at SIB Tower, Kakkanad, without sharing unpublished price-sensitive information.

On 17 July 2026 South Indian Bank's Q1FY27 call reported NIM of 3.23% (up 28 bps QoQ), gross NPA of 1.38% and the highest-ever quarterly NII of ₹1,025 Cr, with MD P.R. Seshadri saying it was his last call in that role.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): interest earned ₹2,795.7 Cr (+16.1% YoY), net profit ₹426.34 Cr (+21.3% YoY).
The South Indian Bank Limited’s **Jimmy Mathew** shared the audio recording of the Investors/Analysts Conference Call held on October 16, 2026, at 16:00 hrs (IST) via the bank’s website.
South Indian Bank reported Q2FY27 consolidated net profit of ₹426.34 Cr on 16 October 2026, driven by 19% deposit growth and lower gross NPAs.
